probes.py

  1"""Evaluate probe expressions such as ``v(out)``, ``v(a,b)``, ``i(v1)``, ``vdb(out)`` or ``ic(q1)``.
  2
  3Voltage/current functions take a suffix that picks the part of a complex (AC) value:
  4
  5    v, i      magnitude for .ac, the value itself otherwise
  6    vm  im    magnitude          vp  ip    phase in degrees
  7    vdb idb   20 log10 |x|       vr  ir    real part          vi  ii    imaginary part
  8
  9Transistor terminal currents: ``ic ib ie`` (BJT) and ``id ig is`` (MOSFET), flowing *into* the device.
 10"""
 11import re
 12from typing import Any
 13
 14import numpy as np
 15from numpy.typing import NDArray
 16
 17from circuit.components import Bjt, Mosfet
 18from circuit.terminals import BjtTerminals, MosfetTerminals, Terminals
 19from errors import ProbeError
 20from simulate import Solution
 21from spiceParser import PrintRequest
 22from util.spicetext import canonicalNode
 23
 24_CALL = re.compile(r"^([a-z]+)\(([^()]*)\)$")
 25_SUFFIXES = ("", "m", "p", "db", "r", "i")
 26_TERMINAL_CURRENTS: dict[str, tuple[type, Terminals]] = {
 27    "ic": (Bjt, BjtTerminals.COLLECTOR), "ib": (Bjt, BjtTerminals.BASE), "ie": (Bjt, BjtTerminals.EMITTER),
 28    "id": (Mosfet, MosfetTerminals.DRAIN), "ig": (Mosfet, MosfetTerminals.GATE), "is": (Mosfet, MosfetTerminals.SOURCE),
 29}
 30
 31def _part(values: NDArray[Any], suffix: str, isComplex: bool) -> NDArray[np.float64]:
 32    z = np.asarray(values, dtype=np.complex128)
 33    match suffix:
 34        case "":
 35            return np.abs(z) if isComplex else z.real
 36        case "m":
 37            return np.abs(z)
 38        case "p":
 39            return np.degrees(np.angle(z))
 40        case "db":
 41            with np.errstate(divide="ignore"):
 42                return 20.0 * np.log10(np.abs(z))
 43        case "r":
 44            return z.real
 45        case _:
 46            return z.imag
 47
 48def evaluate(probe: str, solution: Solution) -> NDArray[np.float64]:
 49    """The value of `probe` at every point of the solution's axis."""
 50    match = _CALL.match(probe.strip().lower())
 51    if match is None:
 52        raise ProbeError(f"{probe!r} is not a probe expression like v(out) or i(r1)")
 53    function, argument = match.groups()
 54    names = [name.strip() for name in argument.split(",")]
 55
 56    if function in _TERMINAL_CURRENTS:
 57        kind, terminal = _TERMINAL_CURRENTS[function]
 58        device = solution.devices.get(names[0]) if len(names) == 1 else None
 59        if not isinstance(device, kind):
 60            raise ProbeError(f"{probe}: {names[0]!r} is not a {kind.__name__.upper()} in the circuit")
 61        return _part(solution.terminalCurrents[device.name][terminal], "", solution.isComplex)
 62
 63    for base in ("v", "i"):
 64        if function.startswith(base) and function[1:] in _SUFFIXES:
 65            suffix = function[1:]
 66            break
 67    else:
 68        raise ProbeError(f"{probe}: unknown function {function!r}")
 69
 70    if base == "v":
 71        if len(names) not in (1, 2) or not all(names):
 72            raise ProbeError(f"{probe}: v() takes one node, or two for a difference")
 73        nodes = [canonicalNode(name) for name in names]
 74        for node in nodes:
 75            if node not in solution.voltages:
 76                raise ProbeError(f"{probe}: there is no node {node!r}")
 77        value = solution.voltages[nodes[0]] - (solution.voltages[nodes[1]] if len(nodes) == 2 else 0.0)
 78        return _part(value, suffix, solution.isComplex)
 79
 80    if len(names) != 1 or not names[0]:
 81        raise ProbeError(f"{probe}: i() takes one device name")
 82    name = names[0]
 83    if name not in solution.devices:
 84        raise ProbeError(f"{probe}: there is no device {name!r}")
 85    if name not in solution.currents:
 86        raise ProbeError(f"{probe}: {name!r} has more than two terminals; use ic/ib/ie (BJT) or id/ig/is (MOSFET)")
 87    return _part(solution.currents[name], suffix, solution.isComplex)
 88
 89def defaultProbes(solution: Solution) -> tuple[str, ...]:
 90    """Every node voltage, plus the current through each voltage source."""
 91    nodes = [f"v({node})" for node in solution.voltages if node != "0"]
 92    sources = [f"i({name})" for name, device in solution.devices.items() if device.letter == "V"]
 93    return tuple(nodes + sources)
 94
 95def probesFor(solution: Solution, requests: list[PrintRequest]) -> tuple[str, ...]:
 96    """The probes to show for a solution: those of matching ``.print/.plot/.probe`` lines, else the defaults."""
 97    chosen: list[str] = []
 98    for request in requests:
 99        if request.analysis in (None, solution.analysis.kind):
100            chosen.extend(probe for probe in request.probes if probe not in chosen)
101    return tuple(chosen) or defaultProbes(solution)

project_flowchart.py

  1#!/usr/bin/env python3
  2"""Generate one Graphviz flowchart of a Python project's classes and call relationships.
  3
  4Usage:
  5    python project_flowchart.py path/to/main.py
  6    python project_flowchart.py path/to/main.py --format pdf
  7    python project_flowchart.py path/to/main.py -o architecture.svg
  8
  9Install:
 10    python -m pip install graphviz
 11    Also install the Graphviz system application from https://graphviz.org/download/
 12"""
 13from __future__ import annotations
 14
 15import argparse
 16import ast
 17import sys
 18from collections import defaultdict
 19from dataclasses import dataclass, field
 20from pathlib import Path
 21
 22IGNORED_DIRS = {
 23    ".git", ".hg", ".svn", ".venv", "venv", "env", "__pycache__",
 24    ".mypy_cache", ".pytest_cache", ".ruff_cache", "site-packages",
 25    "build", "dist", "node_modules",
 26}
 27
 28
 29def dotted_name(node: ast.AST) -> str | None:
 30    if isinstance(node, ast.Name):
 31        return node.id
 32    if isinstance(node, ast.Attribute):
 33        prefix = dotted_name(node.value)
 34        return f"{prefix}.{node.attr}" if prefix else node.attr
 35    if isinstance(node, ast.Call):
 36        return dotted_name(node.func)
 37    return None
 38
 39
 40def quote(value: str) -> str:
 41    return '"' + value.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace('"', '\\"').replace("\n", "\\n") + '"'
 42
 43
 44@dataclass
 45class Definition:
 46    key: str
 47    name: str
 48    kind: str
 49    file: Path
 50    line: int
 51    calls: set[str] = field(default_factory=set)
 52    bases: set[str] = field(default_factory=set)
 53    methods: set[str] = field(default_factory=set)
 54
 55
 56class Analyzer:
 57    def __init__(self, main_file: Path):
 58        self.main_file = main_file.resolve()
 59        self.root = self.main_file.parent
 60        self.definitions: dict[str, Definition] = {}
 61        self.short_names: dict[str, set[str]] = defaultdict(set)
 62        self.imports: dict[Path, dict[str, str]] = defaultdict(dict)
 63        self.class_keys: set[str] = set()
 64
 65    def files(self) -> list[Path]:
 66        found = []
 67        for p in self.root.rglob("*.py"):
 68            rel = p.relative_to(self.root)
 69            if any(part in IGNORED_DIRS for part in rel.parts):
 70                continue
 71            found.append(p.resolve())
 72        if self.main_file.exists() and self.main_file not in found:
 73            found.append(self.main_file)
 74        return sorted(set(found))
 75
 76    def module_name(self, path: Path) -> str:
 77        parts = list(path.relative_to(self.root).with_suffix("").parts)
 78        if parts and parts[-1] == "__init__":
 79            parts.pop()
 80        return ".".join(parts) or path.stem
 81
 82    def parse(self, path: Path) -> ast.Module | None:
 83        try:
 84            return ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), filename=str(path))
 85        except (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError, SyntaxError) as exc:
 86            print(f"Warning: cannot parse {path}: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
 87            return None
 88
 89    def collect_imports(self, tree: ast.Module, path: Path) -> None:
 90        module = self.module_name(path)
 91        for node in ast.walk(tree):
 92            if isinstance(node, ast.Import):
 93                for alias in node.names:
 94                    self.imports[path][alias.asname or alias.name.split(".")[0]] = alias.name
 95            elif isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom):
 96                base = node.module or ""
 97                if node.level:
 98                    parts = module.split(".")[:-1]
 99                    for _ in range(max(0, node.level - 1)):
100                        if parts:
101                            parts.pop()
102                    base = ".".join(parts + ([base] if base else []))
103                for alias in node.names:
104                    if alias.name != "*":
105                        self.imports[path][alias.asname or alias.name] = f"{base}.{alias.name}".strip(".")
106
107    def collect(self, tree: ast.Module, path: Path) -> None:
108        module = self.module_name(path)
109
110        def collect_calls(node: ast.AST, owner: str) -> None:
111            # Walk this callable, but do not attribute nested callable bodies to it.
112            for child in ast.walk(node):
113                if child is not node and isinstance(
114                    child, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef, ast.ClassDef)
115                ):
116                    continue
117                if isinstance(child, ast.Call):
118                    name = dotted_name(child.func)
119                    if name:
120                        self.definitions[owner].calls.add(name)
121
122        def visit(body: list[ast.stmt], scope: list[str]) -> None:
123            for node in body:
124                if isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef):
125                    full = ".".join([module, *scope, node.name])
126                    key = "class:" + full
127                    bases = {name for base in node.bases if (name := dotted_name(base))}
128                    self.definitions[key] = Definition(key, full, "class", path, node.lineno, bases=bases)
129                    self.short_names[node.name].add(key)
130                    self.class_keys.add(key)
131                    for child in node.body:
132                        if isinstance(child, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)):
133                            method_full = ".".join([module, *scope, node.name, child.name])
134                            method_key = "method:" + method_full
135                            self.definitions[method_key] = Definition(
136                                method_key, method_full, "method", path, child.lineno
137                            )
138                            self.short_names[child.name].add(method_key)
139                            self.definitions[key].methods.add(method_key)
140                            collect_calls(child, method_key)
141                        elif isinstance(child, ast.ClassDef):
142                            visit([child], [*scope, node.name])
143                        elif isinstance(child, (ast.If, ast.Try, ast.For, ast.While, ast.With)):
144                            visit(child.body, [*scope, node.name])
145                            for attr in ("orelse", "finalbody"):
146                                branch = getattr(child, attr, [])
147                                if branch:
148                                    visit(branch, [*scope, node.name])
149                elif isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)):
150                    full = ".".join([module, *scope, node.name])
151                    key = "function:" + full
152                    self.definitions[key] = Definition(key, full, "function", path, node.lineno)
153                    self.short_names[node.name].add(key)
154                    collect_calls(node, key)
155                elif isinstance(node, (ast.If, ast.Try, ast.For, ast.While, ast.With)):
156                    visit(node.body, scope)
157                    for attr in ("orelse", "finalbody"):
158                        branch = getattr(node, attr, [])
159                        if branch:
160                            visit(branch, scope)
161
162        visit(tree.body, [])
163
164    def resolve(self, caller: Definition, call: str) -> set[str]:
165        result: set[str] = set()
166        imports = self.imports.get(caller.file, {})
167        first, dot, rest = call.partition(".")
168        if first in imports:
169            expanded = imports[first] + (("." + rest) if dot else "")
170            result |= self.match_qualified(expanded)
171        result |= self.match_qualified(call)
172        if not result:
173            matches = self.short_names.get(call.rsplit(".", 1)[-1], set())
174            if len(matches) == 1:
175                result |= matches
176            else:
177                methods = {key for key in matches if self.definitions[key].kind == "method"}
178                if len(methods) == 1:
179                    result |= methods
180        return result
181
182    def match_qualified(self, name: str) -> set[str]:
183        return {
184            key for key, d in self.definitions.items()
185            if d.name == name or d.name.endswith("." + name)
186        }
187
188    def analyze(self) -> None:
189        trees: dict[Path, ast.Module] = {}
190        for file in self.files():
191            tree = self.parse(file)
192            if tree is not None:
193                trees[file] = tree
194                self.collect_imports(tree, file)
195        for file, tree in trees.items():
196            self.collect(tree, file)
197
198    def to_dot(self, show_files: bool = False, include_external: bool = False) -> str:
199        out = [
200            "digraph PythonProject {",
201            '  graph [rankdir="LR", splines=true, overlap=false, pad="0.25", nodesep="0.25", ranksep="0.8", label="Python Project Flowchart", labelloc="t", fontname="Helvetica"];',
202            '  node [fontname="Helvetica", fontsize="9", style="filled", color="#555555"];',
203            '  edge [fontname="Helvetica", fontsize="8", color="#666666", arrowsize="0.65"];',
204        ]
205        for key, d in sorted(self.definitions.items()):
206            label = d.name
207            if show_files:
208                label += f"\n{d.file.relative_to(self.root)}:{d.line}"
209            if d.kind == "class":
210                attrs = 'shape="box", fillcolor="#DCEBFA", penwidth="1.4"'
211            elif d.kind == "method":
212                attrs = 'shape="ellipse", fillcolor="#E5F4E3"'
213            else:
214                attrs = 'shape="component", fillcolor="#FFF0CC"'
215            out.append(f"  {quote(key)} [{attrs}, label={quote(label)}];")
216
217        edges: set[tuple[str, str, str]] = set()
218        for key in self.class_keys:
219            cls = self.definitions[key]
220            for method in cls.methods:
221                edges.add((key, method, "contains"))
222            for base in cls.bases:
223                parents = self.match_qualified(base)
224                if not parents:
225                    parents = self.short_names.get(base.rsplit(".", 1)[-1], set())
226                for parent in parents:
227                    if self.definitions[parent].kind == "class":
228                        edges.add((parent, key, "inherits"))
229
230        external: dict[str, str] = {}
231        for caller in self.definitions.values():
232            for call in caller.calls:
233                targets = self.resolve(caller, call)
234                for target in targets:
235                    if target != caller.key:
236                        edges.add((caller.key, target, "calls"))
237                if include_external and not targets:
238                    external["external:" + call] = call
239
240        for key, label in sorted(external.items()):
241            out.append(f"  {quote(key)} [shape=plaintext, fontcolor=\"#777777\", label={quote(label)}];")
242        for source, target, label in sorted(edges):
243            if label == "inherits":
244                attrs = 'style="dashed", color="#5B79A6", arrowhead="empty"'
245            elif label == "contains":
246                attrs = 'style="dotted", color="#8A8A8A", arrowhead="none"'
247            else:
248                attrs = 'color="#444444", arrowhead="normal"'
249            out.append(f"  {quote(source)} -> {quote(target)} [label={quote(label)}, {attrs}];")
250        if include_external:
251            for caller in self.definitions.values():
252                for call in caller.calls:
253                    if not self.resolve(caller, call):
254                        out.append(
255                            f"  {quote(caller.key)} -> {quote('external:' + call)} "
256                            '[label="external call", style="dashed", color="#AAAAAA"];'
257                        )
258        out.append("}")
259        return "\n".join(out) + "\n"
260
261
262def main() -> int:
263    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Generate one Graphviz flowchart for a Python project.")
264    parser.add_argument("main_module", type=Path, help="Path to the project's main .py file")
265    parser.add_argument("-o", "--output", type=Path, help="Output file (.svg, .pdf, .png, or .dot)")
266    parser.add_argument("--format", choices=("svg", "pdf", "png", "dot"), default=None)
267    parser.add_argument("--show-files", action="store_true", help="Include relative source paths and line numbers")
268    parser.add_argument("--include-external", action="store_true", help="Show unresolved/library calls (can clutter the graph)")
269    args = parser.parse_args()
270
271    main_file = args.main_module.expanduser().resolve()
272    if not main_file.is_file() or main_file.suffix != ".py":
273        parser.error(f"expected an existing Python file: {main_file}")
274
275    output_format = args.format
276    if args.output and output_format is None:
277        suffix = args.output.suffix.lower().lstrip(".")
278        output_format = suffix if suffix in {"svg", "pdf", "png", "dot"} else "svg"
279    output_format = output_format or "svg"
280    output = (args.output or main_file.with_name(f"{main_file.stem}_flowchart.{output_format}")).expanduser().resolve()
281
282    analyzer = Analyzer(main_file)
283    analyzer.analyze()
284    if not analyzer.definitions:
285        print("No classes, functions, or methods found.", file=sys.stderr)
286        return 1
287
288    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
289    dot = analyzer.to_dot(args.show_files, args.include_external)
290    if output_format == "dot":
291        output.write_text(dot, encoding="utf-8")
292    else:
293        try:
294            import graphviz
295        except ImportError:
296            print("Install the Python package with: python -m pip install graphviz", file=sys.stderr)
297            print("Also install Graphviz itself: https://graphviz.org/download/", file=sys.stderr)
298            return 2
299        try:
300            source = graphviz.Source(dot, filename=str(output.with_suffix("")), format=output_format)
301            rendered = Path(source.render(cleanup=True))
302            if rendered.resolve() != output.resolve():
303                rendered.replace(output)
304        except graphviz.backend.ExecutableNotFound:
305            print("Graphviz 'dot' executable not found. Install Graphviz and ensure it is on PATH.", file=sys.stderr)
306            return 2
307        except graphviz.backend.CalledProcessError as exc:
308            print(f"Graphviz failed: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
309            return 2
310
311    print(f"Analysed {len(analyzer.definitions)} definitions.")
312    print(f"Flowchart written to: {output}")
313    if output_format == "svg":
314        print("Open the SVG in a browser; zoom in to inspect dense areas.")
315    return 0
316
317
318if __name__ == "__main__":
319    raise SystemExit(main())

report.py

 1"""Turn solutions into text tables and CSV files."""
 2import csv
 3from pathlib import Path
 4
 5import numpy as np
 6
 7from probes import evaluate
 8from simulate import Solution
 9from spiceParser import AcAnalysis, DcSweep, OpAnalysis, TranAnalysis
10
11def describe(solution: Solution) -> str:
12    match solution.analysis:
13        case OpAnalysis():
14            return "DC operating point"
15        case DcSweep(source=name, start=start, stop=stop, step=step):
16            return f"DC sweep of {name} from {start:g} to {stop:g} in steps of {step:g}"
17        case AcAnalysis(variation=variation, points=points, start=start, stop=stop):
18            return f"AC sweep, {points} points ({variation}) from {start:g} Hz to {stop:g} Hz"
19        case TranAnalysis(stop=stop):
20            return f"Transient analysis to {stop:g} s"
21
22def formatTable(solution: Solution, probes: tuple[str, ...], maxRows: int | None = None) -> str:
23    """A text rendering: name = value lines for .op, one row per point otherwise.
24
25    With `maxRows`, a longer table shows that many evenly spaced points (always including the first and last)."""
26    columns = {probe: evaluate(probe, solution) for probe in probes}
27    lines = [describe(solution), ""]
28
29    if isinstance(solution.analysis, OpAnalysis):
30        width = max((len(probe) for probe in probes), default=0)
31        lines += [f"{probe:<{width}} = {values[0]:.6g}" for probe, values in columns.items()]
32        return "\n".join(lines)
33
34    headers = [solution.axisName, *probes]
35    widths = [max(14, len(header)) for header in headers]
36    lines.append("  ".join(f"{header:>{width}}" for header, width in zip(headers, widths)))
37    lines.append("  ".join("-" * width for width in widths))
38    count = solution.axis.size
39    rows = range(count) if maxRows is None or count <= maxRows else sorted({int(k) for k in np.linspace(0, count - 1, maxRows)})
40    for k in rows:
41        cells = [solution.axis[k], *(values[k] for values in columns.values())]
42        lines.append("  ".join(f"{cell:>{width}.6e}" for cell, width in zip(cells, widths)))
43    if len(rows) < count:
44        lines += ["", f"showing {len(rows)} of {count} points; export to CSV to get all of them"]
45    return "\n".join(lines)
46
47def writeCsv(path: Path, solution: Solution, probes: tuple[str, ...]) -> None:
48    columns = [evaluate(probe, solution) for probe in probes]
49    with open(path, "w", newline="") as f:
50        writer = csv.writer(f)
51        writer.writerow([solution.axisName or "point", *probes])
52        for k in range(solution.axis.size):
53            writer.writerow([f"{solution.axis[k]:.9g}", *(f"{float(np.real(column[k])):.9g}" for column in columns)])

simulate.py

  1"""Run a parsed netlist's analyses and collect the answers in one uniform shape (`Solution`)."""
  2import math
  3from collections.abc import Mapping
  4from dataclasses import dataclass, replace
  5from typing import Any, Literal
  6
  7import numpy as np
  8from numpy.typing import NDArray
  9
 10from circuit.circuit import buildCircuit
 11from circuit.components import Component, CurrentSource, VoltageSource
 12from circuit.terminals import Terminals
 13from errors import SimulationError
 14from solver.options import NewtonOptions
 15from solver.solver import solveAc, solveDc, solveTransient
 16from solver.waveformHelpers import FloatArray, linearSweep, logSweep, octaveSweep
 17from spiceParser import AcAnalysis, Analysis, DcSweep, Netlist, OpAnalysis, TranAnalysis, flatten
 18
 19GROUND = "0"
 20MAX_POINTS = 1_000_000   # refuse sweeps and transients bigger than this rather than run out of memory
 21
 22@dataclass(frozen=True)
 23class Solution:
 24    """The result of one analysis. Every quantity is an array with one entry per point of `axis`
 25    (a single point for ``.op``); the arrays are complex for ``.ac`` and real otherwise."""
 26    analysis: Analysis
 27    axisName: str                                   # "" for .op, else "time", "frequency" or the swept source
 28    axis: FloatArray
 29    voltages: Mapping[str, NDArray[Any]]            # by node
 30    currents: Mapping[str, NDArray[Any]]            # by two-terminal device: first terminal -> second
 31    terminalCurrents: Mapping[str, Mapping[Terminals, NDArray[Any]]]
 32    devices: Mapping[str, Component]
 33
 34    @property
 35    def isComplex(self) -> bool:
 36        return isinstance(self.analysis, AcAnalysis)
 37
 38def solverOptions(netlist: Netlist) -> tuple[float, NewtonOptions]:
 39    """``(gmin, NewtonOptions)`` from the netlist's ``.options`` line."""
 40    o = netlist.options
 41    defaults = NewtonOptions()
 42    return o.get("gmin", 1e-12), NewtonOptions(
 43        maxIterations=int(o.get("itl1", defaults.maxIterations)),
 44        reltol=o.get("reltol", defaults.reltol),
 45        vntol=o.get("vntol", defaults.vntol),
 46        abstol=o.get("abstol", defaults.abstol),
 47    )
 48
 49def _requireGround(components: list[Component]) -> None:
 50    if not any(GROUND in component.nodes for component in components):
 51        raise SimulationError("the circuit has no ground node: connect something to node 0 (or gnd)")
 52
 53def _acFrequencies(analysis: AcAnalysis) -> FloatArray:
 54    try:
 55        match analysis.variation:
 56            case "dec":
 57                return logSweep(analysis.start, analysis.stop, analysis.points)
 58            case "oct":
 59                return octaveSweep(analysis.start, analysis.stop, analysis.points)
 60            case _:
 61                return linearSweep(analysis.start, analysis.stop, analysis.points)
 62    except ValueError as error:
 63        raise SimulationError(f".ac (line {analysis.line}): {error}") from None
 64
 65def _sweepValues(analysis: DcSweep) -> FloatArray:
 66    count = math.floor((analysis.stop - analysis.start) / analysis.step + 1e-9) + 1
 67    if count > MAX_POINTS:
 68        raise SimulationError(f".dc (line {analysis.line}) would need {count} points; the limit is {MAX_POINTS}")
 69    return analysis.start + analysis.step * np.arange(count, dtype=np.float64)
 70
 71def runAnalysis(
 72    netlist: Netlist, analysis: Analysis, components: list[Component], *,
 73    method: Literal["trapezoidal", "backward_euler"] = "trapezoidal",
 74) -> Solution:
 75    """Run one analysis on the flat device list."""
 76    _requireGround(components)
 77    gmin, options = solverOptions(netlist)
 78    devices = {component.name: component for component in components}
 79    circuit = buildCircuit(components)
 80
 81    match analysis:
 82        case OpAnalysis():
 83            r = solveDc(circuit, GROUND, gmin=gmin, options=options)
 84            return Solution(
 85                analysis, "", np.zeros(1),
 86                {node: np.array([v]) for node, v in r.voltages.items()},
 87                {edge: np.array([i]) for edge, i in r.currents.items()},
 88                {edge: {role: np.array([i]) for role, i in roles.items()} for edge, roles in r.terminalCurrents.items()},
 89                devices,
 90            )
 91
 92        case DcSweep(source=name):
 93            target = devices.get(name)
 94            if not isinstance(target, (VoltageSource, CurrentSource)):
 95                raise SimulationError(f".dc (line {analysis.line}): {name!r} is not an independent voltage or current source in the circuit")
 96            values = _sweepValues(analysis)
 97            results = []
 98            for value in values:
 99                swept = replace(target, source=replace(target.source, dc=float(value)))
100                point = buildCircuit(swept if c.name == name else c for c in components)
101                results.append(solveDc(point, GROUND, gmin=gmin, options=options))
102            first = results[0]
103            return Solution(
104                analysis, name, values,
105                {node: np.array([r.voltages[node] for r in results]) for node in first.voltages},
106                {edge: np.array([r.currents[edge] for r in results]) for edge in first.currents},
107                {edge: {role: np.array([r.terminalCurrents[edge][role] for r in results]) for role in roles}
108                 for edge, roles in first.terminalCurrents.items()},
109                devices,
110            )
111
112        case AcAnalysis():
113            freqs = _acFrequencies(analysis)
114            if freqs.size > MAX_POINTS:
115                raise SimulationError(f".ac (line {analysis.line}) would need {freqs.size} points; the limit is {MAX_POINTS}")
116            r = solveAc(circuit, GROUND, freqs, gmin=gmin, options=options)
117            return Solution(analysis, "frequency", r.frequencies, r.voltages, r.currents, r.terminalCurrents, devices)
118
119        case TranAnalysis():
120            step = analysis.step if analysis.max_step is None else min(analysis.step, analysis.max_step)
121            if analysis.stop / step > MAX_POINTS:
122                raise SimulationError(
123                    f".tran (line {analysis.line}) would need {analysis.stop / step:.3g} time points; the limit is {MAX_POINTS}. "
124                    "Increase tstep or shorten tstop")
125            r = solveTransient(
126                circuit, GROUND, stop=analysis.stop, step=step, method=method,
127                useInitialConditions=analysis.use_initial_conditions, gmin=gmin, options=options,
128            )
129            keep = r.times >= analysis.start - 1e-12 * analysis.stop   # tstart only hides the early part of the output
130            return Solution(
131                analysis, "time", r.times[keep],
132                {node: v[keep] for node, v in r.voltages.items()},
133                {edge: i[keep] for edge, i in r.currents.items()},
134                {edge: {role: i[keep] for role, i in roles.items()} for edge, roles in r.terminalCurrents.items()},
135                devices,
136            )
137
138def simulate(
139    netlist: Netlist, *, method: Literal["trapezoidal", "backward_euler"] = "trapezoidal",
140) -> tuple[list[Solution], list[str]]:
141    """Run every analysis in the netlist (an ``.op`` if it has none). Returns the solutions and any warnings."""
142    components = flatten(netlist)
143    warnings = list(netlist.warnings)
144
145    analyses = list(netlist.analyses)
146    if not analyses:
147        warnings.append("no analysis (.op, .dc, .ac, .tran) in the netlist; running .op")
148        analyses = [OpAnalysis()]
149
150    if any(isinstance(a, AcAnalysis) for a in analyses) and not any(
151        isinstance(c, (VoltageSource, CurrentSource)) and c.source.ac != 0 for c in components
152    ):
153        warnings.append(".ac analysis requested but no source has an AC value (add e.g. 'ac 1' to a source), so every result will be zero")
154
155    return [runAnalysis(netlist, analysis, components, method=method) for analysis in analyses], warnings

spiceParser.py

  1"""Read a SPICE netlist into a `Netlist`, and flatten its subcircuits.
  2
  3    netlist = parseNetlist("amp.cir")          # or parseText(text)
  4    components = flatten(netlist)              # one flat list of primitive devices
  5
  6Supported: R C L V I D Q M devices, ``X`` subcircuit instances, ``.model`` (d npn pnp nmos pmos),
  7``.subckt/.ends``, ``.op .dc .ac .tran``, ``.print/.plot/.probe``, ``.options``. Directives that would
  8change the answer if ignored are rejected; directives that only matter for output are accepted.
  9"""
 10import re
 11from collections.abc import Iterator
 12from dataclasses import dataclass, field, replace
 13from typing import ClassVar, Literal
 14
 15from circuit.components import COMPONENT_TYPES, Component, ParseContext
 16from circuit.modelcard import ModelCard
 17from errors import CircuitError, SpiceError
 18from util.spicetext import canonicalNode, isValue, parseValue
 19
 20_INLINE_COMMENT_REGEX = re.compile(r";.*$|(?:^|\s)\$.*$")
 21_PROBE_REGEX = re.compile(r"\w+\([^()]*\)")
 22
 23# Directives that would change the circuit if ignored, so they are rejected instead.
 24_UNSUPPORTED_DIRECTIVES = (
 25    ".param", ".include", ".inc", ".lib", ".func", ".global", ".measure", ".meas", ".step",
 26    ".noise", ".tf", ".sens", ".four", ".disto", ".pz", ".data", ".if"
 27)
 28# Directives that do not affect results (or are only hints), accepted and ignored.
 29_HARMLESS_DIRECTIVES = (".save", ".width")
 30# Directives that do affect results but cannot be honoured here, so they are ignored *with a warning*.
 31_WARN_DIRECTIVES = (".ic", ".nodeset", ".temp")
 32
 33def _looksLikeDevice(title: str) -> bool:
 34    """Whether a title line looks like it was meant to be a component, e.g. ``r1 a b 1k`` or ``d1 a k dmod``."""
 35    tokens = title.lower().split()
 36    if len(tokens) < 4 or not re.fullmatch(r"[\w.]+", tokens[0]):
 37        return False
 38    if tokens[0][0] in "rclvi":   # name node node value: the fourth token is a number or a source keyword
 39        return isValue(tokens[3]) or tokens[3] in ("dc", "ac", "sin", "pulse", "pwl", "exp")
 40    return tokens[0][0] in "dqmx" and any(ch.isdigit() for ch in tokens[0])
 41
 42def _value(text: str, line: int, quantity: str) -> float:
 43    """`parseValue` that reports failures as a `SpiceError` pointing at the line."""
 44    try:
 45        return parseValue(text)
 46    except ValueError:
 47        raise SpiceError(f"{quantity} {text!r} is not a number", line) from None
 48
 49
 50# ---- parsed pieces -------------------------------------------------------------
 51
 52@dataclass(frozen=True)
 53class Instance:
 54    """An ``X`` line: a use of a subcircuit, not yet expanded."""
 55    name: str
 56    line: int
 57    nodes: tuple[str, ...]
 58    subcircuit: str
 59
 60type Element = Component | Instance
 61
 62@dataclass(frozen=True)
 63class Subcircuit:
 64    name: str
 65    terminals: list[str]
 66    components: list[Element] = field(default_factory=list[Element])
 67    line: int = 0
 68
 69@dataclass(frozen=True)
 70class OpAnalysis:
 71    """``.op``: DC operating point."""
 72    kind: ClassVar[str] = "op"
 73    line: int = 0
 74
 75@dataclass(frozen=True)
 76class DcSweep:
 77    """``.dc source start stop step``: repeat the operating point while sweeping one source."""
 78    source: str
 79    start: float
 80    stop: float
 81    step: float
 82    line: int = 0
 83    kind: ClassVar[str] = "dc"
 84
 85@dataclass(frozen=True)
 86class AcAnalysis:
 87    """``.ac dec|oct|lin points start stop``: small-signal frequency sweep."""
 88    variation: Literal["dec", "oct", "lin"]
 89    points: int
 90    start: float
 91    stop: float
 92    line: int = 0
 93    kind: ClassVar[str] = "ac"
 94
 95@dataclass(frozen=True)
 96class TranAnalysis:
 97    """``.tran tstep tstop [tstart [tmax]] [uic]``: time-domain simulation."""
 98    step: float
 99    stop: float
100    start: float = 0.0
101    max_step: float | None = None
102    use_initial_conditions: bool = False
103    line: int = 0
104    kind: ClassVar[str] = "tran"
105
106type Analysis = OpAnalysis | DcSweep | AcAnalysis | TranAnalysis
107
108@dataclass(frozen=True)
109class PrintRequest:
110    """A ``.print``, ``.plot`` or ``.probe`` line: which quantities the user wants to see."""
111    analysis: str | None
112    probes: tuple[str, ...]
113
114@dataclass
115class Netlist:
116    """A parsed netlist."""
117    title: str = ""
118    components: list[Element] = field(default_factory=list[Element])
119    models: dict[str, ModelCard] = field(default_factory=dict[str, ModelCard])
120    subcircuits: dict[str, Subcircuit] = field(default_factory=dict[str, Subcircuit])
121    analyses: list[Analysis] = field(default_factory=list[Analysis])
122    prints: list[PrintRequest] = field(default_factory=list[PrintRequest])
123    options: dict[str, float] = field(default_factory=dict[str, float])
124    warnings: list[str] = field(default_factory=list[str])
125
126
127# ---- reading lines ---------------------------------------------------------------
128
129@dataclass(frozen=True)
130class LogicalLine:
131    """One statement after comments are removed and continuation lines are joined."""
132    number: int   # 1-based number of the physical line it started on
133    text: str
134
135def readLines(text: str) -> Iterator[LogicalLine]:
136    """Yield the title, then each statement with comments stripped and ``+`` continuations joined."""
137    rawLines = text.splitlines()
138    if not rawLines:
139        return
140
141    # first line of a SPICE file is always the title
142    yield LogicalLine(1, rawLines[0].strip())
143
144    pending: LogicalLine | None = None
145    for number, raw in enumerate(rawLines[1:], start=2):
146        line = _INLINE_COMMENT_REGEX.sub("", raw).strip()
147        if not line or line.startswith("*"):
148            continue
149        if line.startswith("+"):
150            if pending is None:
151                raise SpiceError("continuation line (+) has nothing to continue", number)
152            pending = LogicalLine(pending.number, f"{pending.text} {line[1:].strip()}")
153        else:
154            if pending is not None:
155                yield pending
156            pending = LogicalLine(number, line)
157    if pending is not None:
158        yield pending
159
160def _tokens(text: str) -> list[str]:
161    """Lower-case tokens, with ``(``, ``)`` and ``,`` as whitespace and ``a = b`` tightened to ``a=b``."""
162    return re.sub(r"[(),]", " ", re.sub(r"\s*=\s*", "=", text.strip().lower())).split()
163
164
165# ---- elements ----------------------------------------------------------------------
166
167def parseElement(line: LogicalLine, context: ParseContext) -> Element:
168    """Parse one device or subcircuit-instance line."""
169    name, *tokens = _tokens(line.text)
170
171    positional: list[str] = []
172    parameters: dict[str, str] = {}
173    for token in tokens:
174        if len(pair := token.split("=", 1)) == 2:
175            parameters[pair[0]] = pair[1]
176        else:
177            positional.append(token)
178
179    if name[0] == "x":
180        if parameters or len(positional) < 1:
181            raise SpiceError(f"{name}: expected 'node... subcircuit-name' (subcircuit parameters are not supported)", line.number)
182        return Instance(name, line.number, tuple(canonicalNode(node) for node in positional[:-1]), positional[-1])
183
184    kind = COMPONENT_TYPES.get(name[0])
185    if kind is None:
186        supported = ", ".join(letter.upper() for letter in (*COMPONENT_TYPES, "x"))
187        raise SpiceError(f"Unknown or unsupported component: {name} (supported device letters: {supported})", line.number)
188
189    component = kind.parse(name, line.number, positional, parameters, context)
190    try:
191        component.validate(name)
192    except CircuitError as error:
193        raise SpiceError(str(error), line.number) from None
194    if name[0] == "m":
195        context.warn(line.number, f"{name}: the bulk terminal is ignored (this MOSFET model has no body effect)")
196    return component
197
198
199# ---- directives --------------------------------------------------------------------
200
201def parseDirective(netlist: Netlist, line: LogicalLine, word: str) -> None:
202    """Handle one dot-directive other than ``.subckt``/``.ends``/``.end``, recording it on `netlist`."""
203    tokens = _tokens(line.text)
204    match word:
205        case ".title":
206            netlist.title = line.text.split(None, 1)[1] if len(line.text.split(None, 1)) > 1 else ""
207
208        case ".model":
209            if len(tokens) < 3:
210                raise SpiceError(".model needs a name and a type", line.number)
211            _, name, kind, *rest = tokens
212
213            if kind not in ("d", "npn", "pnp", "nmos", "pmos"):
214                raise SpiceError(f".model type {kind!r} is not supported (use d, npn, pnp, nmos or pmos)", line.number)
215
216            parameters: dict[str, float] = {}
217            for token in rest:
218                if len(pair := token.split("=", 1)) != 2:
219                    raise SpiceError(f".model {name}: expected name=value, got {token!r}", line.number)
220                parameters[pair[0]] = _value(pair[1], line.number, f"model parameter {pair[0]}")
221            netlist.models[name] = ModelCard(name, kind, parameters, line.number)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
222
223        case ".op":
224            netlist.analyses.append(OpAnalysis(line=line.number))
225
226        case ".dc":
227            if len(tokens) == 9:
228                raise SpiceError("nested .dc sweeps (a second source) are not supported", line.number)
229            if len(tokens) != 5:
230                raise SpiceError(".dc source needs: source start stop step", line.number)
231            start, stop, step = (_value(token, line.number, ".dc value") for token in tokens[2:])
232            if step == 0 or (stop - start) / step < 0:
233                raise SpiceError(".dc step must be non-zero and point from start towards stop", line.number)
234            netlist.analyses.append(DcSweep(tokens[1], start, stop, step, line.number))
235
236        case ".ac":
237            if len(tokens) != 5 or tokens[1] not in ("dec", "oct", "lin"):
238                raise SpiceError(".ac needs: dec|oct|lin points fstart fstop", line.number)
239            variation = tokens[1]
240            points = int(_value(tokens[2], line.number, ".ac point count"))
241            fStart = _value(tokens[3], line.number, ".ac start")
242            fStop = _value(tokens[4], line.number, ".ac stop")
243            if points < 1 or fStart < 0 or fStop <= fStart or (variation != "lin" and fStart <= 0):
244                raise SpiceError(".ac needs points >= 1 and 0 < fstart < fstop (fstart may be 0 only for lin)", line.number)
245            netlist.analyses.append(AcAnalysis(variation, points, fStart, fStop, line.number))  # type: ignore[arg-type]
246
247        case ".tran":
248            uic = "uic" in tokens
249            numbers = [_value(token, line.number, ".tran argument") for token in tokens[1:] if token != "uic"]
250            if not 2 <= len(numbers) <= 4:
251                raise SpiceError(".tran needs: tstep tstop [tstart [tmax]] [uic]", line.number)
252            tStep, tStop = numbers[0:2]
253            tStart = numbers[2] if len(numbers) > 2 else 0.0
254            maxStep = numbers[3] if len(numbers) > 3 else None
255            if tStep <= 0 or tStop <= 0 or tStart < 0 or (maxStep is not None and maxStep <= 0):
256                raise SpiceError(".tran times must be positive", line.number)
257            if tStart >= tStop:
258                raise SpiceError(".tran tstart must be less than tstop", line.number)
259            netlist.analyses.append(TranAnalysis(tStep, tStop, tStart, maxStep, uic, line.number))
260
261        case ".print" | ".plot" | ".probe":
262            analysis = tokens[1] if len(tokens) > 1 and tokens[1] in ("op", "dc", "ac", "tran") else None
263            probes = tuple(re.sub(r"\s+", "", p) for p in _PROBE_REGEX.findall(line.text.lower()))
264            if not probes:
265                raise SpiceError(f"{word} needs at least one expression such as v(out)", line.number)
266            netlist.prints.append(PrintRequest(analysis, probes))
267
268        case ".options" | ".option":
269            for token in tokens[1:]:
270                if "=" not in token:
271                    continue
272                key, text = token.split("=", 1)
273                if isValue(text):
274                    netlist.options[key] = parseValue(text)
275                else:
276                    netlist.warnings.append(f"line {line.number}: option {key}={text} is not numeric and was ignored")
277
278        case directive if directive in _WARN_DIRECTIVES:
279            netlist.warnings.append(f"line {line.number}: {word} is not supported and was ignored, so results may differ from SPICE")
280
281        case directive if directive in _HARMLESS_DIRECTIVES:
282            pass
283
284        case directive if directive in _UNSUPPORTED_DIRECTIVES:
285            raise SpiceError(f"{word} is not supported", line.number)
286
287        case _:
288            raise SpiceError(f"unknown directive {word}", line.number)
289
290
291# ---- whole netlists -------------------------------------------------------------------
292
293def parseText(text: str) -> Netlist:
294    """Parse netlist text. Device lines are read after every directive, so a ``.model`` may come after its users."""
295    netlist = Netlist()
296    lines = readLines(text)
297
298    first = next(lines, None)
299    if first is None:
300        raise SpiceError("the netlist is empty")
301    netlist.title = first.text
302    if _looksLikeDevice(first.text):
303        netlist.warnings.append(f"line 1: the first line of a netlist is its title, but {first.text!r} looks like a component, which was not read")
304
305    deferred: list[tuple[LogicalLine, list[Element]]] = []   # device lines, and where their result goes
306    current: Subcircuit | None = None
307    for line in lines:
308        word = line.text.split()[0].lower()
309
310        match word:
311            case ".end":
312                if current is not None:
313                    raise SpiceError(f"subcircuit {current.name!r} is missing .ends", current.line)
314                break
315
316            case ".subckt":
317                if current is not None:
318                    raise SpiceError("nested .subckt definitions are not supported", line.number)
319                tokens = _tokens(line.text)
320                if len(tokens) < 2 or any(token.endswith(":") or "=" in token for token in tokens[2:]):
321                    raise SpiceError(".subckt needs a name and a list of nodes (parameters are not supported)", line.number)
322                name, ports = tokens[1], tokens[2:]
323                if name in netlist.subcircuits:
324                    raise SpiceError(f"subcircuit {name!r} is defined twice", line.number)
325                if "0" in ports or "gnd" in ports or len(set(ports)) != len(ports):
326                    raise SpiceError(f".subckt {name}: ports must be distinct and cannot include ground", line.number)
327                current = netlist.subcircuits[name] = Subcircuit(name, ports, line=line.number)
328
329            case ".ends":
330                if current is None:
331                    raise SpiceError(".ends without a matching .subckt", line.number)
332                current = None
333
334            case directive if not directive.startswith("."):
335                deferred.append((line, current.components if current else netlist.components))
336
337            case directive if directive != ".model" and current is not None:
338                raise SpiceError(f"{word} is not allowed inside a .subckt (only devices and .model)", line.number)
339            
340            case _:
341                parseDirective(netlist, line, word)
342
343    if current is not None:
344        raise SpiceError(f"subcircuit {current.name!r} is missing .ends", current.line)
345
346    context = ParseContext(netlist.models, netlist.warnings)
347    for line, target in deferred:
348        target.append(parseElement(line, context))
349    return netlist
350
351def parseNetlist(filepath: str) -> Netlist:
352    with open(filepath, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
353        return parseText(f.read())
354
355def flatten(netlist: Netlist, maxDepth: int = 16) -> list[Component]:
356    """Expand every subcircuit instance, giving one flat list of primitive components. maxDepth guards
357    against a subcircuit that instantiates itself.
358
359    Inside an instance named ``x1``, a component ``r2`` becomes ``x1.r2``, the subcircuit's port nodes
360    are replaced by the nodes the caller connected, its other nodes become private (``x1.mid``), and
361    node ``0`` stays the global ground. Instances may be nested.
362    """
363    flat: list[Component] = []
364
365    def expand(elements: list[Element], prefix: str, ports: dict[str, str], depth: int) -> None:
366        def local(node: str) -> str:
367            if node == "0":
368                return node
369            return ports.get(node, prefix + node)
370
371        for element in elements:
372            if isinstance(element, Component):
373                flat.append(replace(element, name=prefix + element.name, nodes=tuple(local(node) for node in element.nodes)))
374                continue
375
376            if depth >= maxDepth:
377                raise SpiceError(f"subcircuits nested more than {maxDepth} deep (does {element.subcircuit!r} instantiate itself?)", element.line)
378            subcircuit = netlist.subcircuits.get(element.subcircuit)
379            if subcircuit is None:
380                raise SpiceError(f"{element.name}: subcircuit {element.subcircuit!r} is not defined", element.line)
381            if len(element.nodes) != len(subcircuit.terminals):
382                raise SpiceError(
383                    f"{element.name}: subcircuit {subcircuit.name!r} has {len(subcircuit.terminals)} ports "
384                    f"but {len(element.nodes)} nodes were given", element.line)
385            connections = {port: local(node) for port, node in zip(subcircuit.terminals, element.nodes)}
386            expand(subcircuit.components, f"{prefix}{element.name}.", connections, depth + 1)
387
388    expand(netlist.components, "", {}, 0)
389    return flat
